orientation: Touches money, with checkout as context. The risky one is money: roundToCents now rounds exact half-cent ties to the even cent, which changes order totals and is consumed by 2 services outside this repo.

nodes.label: money

risk.why: Changes how every price rounds; 2 in-repo callers, 2 external consumers, no tests.

nodes.summary: Rounding helpers used by every price calculation. This PR switches roundToCents from half-away-from-zero to banker's rounding, so totals that land exactly on a half cent now round to the even cent.

nodes.label: roundToCents

risk.why: Observable change for every caller; 2 in-repo callers, 1 external consumer, no tests.

nodes.summary: Rounds an amount to whole cents. Exact half-cent ties now go to the even cent (2.345 becomes 2.34, not 2.35), which stops sums drifting upwards but changes some totals by one cent.

nodes.label: formatCents

risk.why: Unchanged, but inherits the new rounding; 1 external consumer formats prices with it.

nodes.summary: Formats an amount as a two-decimal string by calling roundToCents, so displayed prices change wherever a tie occurs.

nodes.label: checkout

risk.why: Not changed; its totals inherit the new rounding.

nodes.summary: Computes order totals. Nothing here changed, but orderTotal rounds through roundToCents.

nodes.label: orderTotal

risk.why: Unchanged caller whose result changes by a cent on ties; no tests.

nodes.summary: Sums price times quantity, applies tax and rounds once at the end with roundToCents. Read it to see which totals can now differ by a cent.

nodes.label: invoice-service

risk.why: Calls roundToCents directly when issuing invoices.

nodes.summary: A service outside this repo that rounds invoice lines with roundToCents. Invoices and order totals must agree, so both need the same rounding.

nodes.label: storefront-web
nodes.summary: The web storefront, outside this repo, formats displayed prices with formatCents.

regions.gist: Header: rounding helpers shared by every price calculation
Rounds to whole cents; exact half-cent ties go to the even cent
Formats an amount as a two-decimal string via roundToCents
A priced order line: unit price and quantity
Sums price x qty, applies tax, rounds the total once
